summary: Initializes two fields of a small struct: writes literal 4 to the DWORD at this+0x4 and 0 to the DWORD at this+0x8, then returns the receiver pointer. Unconditional constructor-style helper with no branches, calls, or globals.

local_names.result: receiver pointer passed in EAX (this) and returned unchanged

operations.description: Writes literal 4 to the DWORD at this+0x4 (category or count field)
Writes 0 to the DWORD at this+0x8 (empty pointer or zero sub-count)
